summary: Patch special-cases extension containing I to bypass _generic_factor and call a different factor implementation entirely, rather than fixing root cause in the domain/extension handling; doesn't address extension=True or other algebraic extensions per issue title.

issues.description: Hack special-cases 'I in extension list' and routes to sympy.simplify.simplify.factor instead of fixing _generic_factor's handling of extensions; wrong abstraction, brittle condition on exact extension contents.
Issue title says 'extension=True' drops factor; patch only handles extension as list containing I, so extension=True or extension=[sqrt(2)] etc. still broken/untouched.
Fix narrowly targets exact reported case (extension=[I]) rather than general bug in multivariate factor+extension path, likely overfit to reproduction test.

Routing through sympy.simplify.simplify.factor for any extension containing I changes behavior/semantics (different algorithm, possible domain mismatch) for all such calls, unverified against broader extension use cases.
